post_template.hook_style: Open with a direct seller or buyer question, a bold local market statement, or a surprising East Auckland-specific insight — e.g. 'Thinking of selling this autumn? Here is what most homeowners miss.' or 'The market just shifted. Here is what it means for your home.' Avoid generic openers with no local context.
post_template.structure: hook → value or education point → local East Auckland relevance → soft CTA
post_template.best_performing_format: Low confidence — insufficient engagement data from Facebook (all metrics returned zero). Based on trend research and best practices, image posts with lifestyle-driven visuals and education-focused captions are recommended as the primary format. Short-form video is a high-priority emerging format per research briefs. Text-only posts are deprioritised until engagement data confirms viability.
retired_formats: Standalone text-only posts with no image or video — all 4 archived posts were text-only with no measurable differentiation; image and video formats are prioritised based on trend research

image_strategy.overlay_style: Short punchy headline overlay in brand black (#000000) or white (#FFFFFF) on clean image areas — 2 to 6 words maximum. Subtle brand red (#C8102E) accent used sparingly for emphasis on key words or divider elements. Leave intentional negative space in compositions for overlay placement. Examples: 'Sell smarter.', 'This one won't last.', 'East Auckland living.'

reasoning.what_worked: Insufficient engagement data to confirm what worked — all Facebook metrics returned zero. Based on posting time patterns, 21:00 and 06:00 were the hours associated with the top five posts in the Facebook insights, and 20:00 was the consistent posting time across all archived local posts. Evening scheduling appears to be the established habit and should be retained. Core brand hashtags were applied consistently across all 4 archived posts which maintains brand discoverability baseline.
reasoning.what_didnt: All 4 archived posts were text-only with no image or video content. This directly contradicts the brand image strategy, research brief recommendations, and general social media best practices for real estate in 2026. Text-only posts have no visual stopping power in a feed-scroll environment and provide no opportunity to showcase property lifestyle, brand aesthetics, or local East Auckland identity. No personal brand content, no sold stories, no suburb spotlights, and no video were present in the archive — all of which are cited as high-performing formats in the research data.
reasoning.main_recommendation: Immediately shift the content mix to a minimum 3:1 image-to-text ratio by introducing lifestyle property photography and at least one short-form video per week. Prioritise autumn seller education content with local East Auckland hooks published at 21:00, and add one sold success story or suburb spotlight post per week to build social proof and local authority. Collect engagement data over the next 30 days to establish a reliable performance baseline before making further tactical adjustments.
